202.description: Receipt accepted and staged; not yet stowed to a bin.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp the receipt was staged, RFC 3339.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this response is a replay of the stored answer for the request's Idempotency-Key (the handler did not run again). The first execution of a key never carries it.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, SKU missing/empty, or the Idempotency-Key header is absent (ADR 0018).
